items.title: Synthetic office-hours notes: what trial teams did
items.excerpt: Synthetic fixture. Session notes, 2026-11-04. A 6-seat design agency on a trial asked support twice in October 2026 to keep its sample project as a template. 3 of 12 interviewed trial teams rebuilt a previous project by hand in their first session. Sales says trial teams are interested in a template gallery. The product manager thinks a starter-template button on the empty workspace could ship in under a week from the existing sample-data fixtures.
